site.context: Searles Lake interstitial process brine (Trona, San Bernardino County, CA); inland playa, not Texas Gulf seawater; not a concession sample

meta.quality: Majors converted from Teeple 1929 ACS monograph 1925 complete analysis (wt% of brine; specific gravity 1.30). NaCl, Na2SO4, KCl, NaBr, LiCl mapped to SUBSTANCES ions; Na+ from Na2CO3 and Na2B4O7 retained (those Na salts are cited) while CO3/borate/phosphate anions are omitted (not in SUBSTANCES). Not a concession sample.
meta.notes: Ion masses are g/kg brine from Teeple salt weight-percent × ion mass fractions using engine/model SUBSTANCES molar masses (Na2CO3/Na2B4O7 Na+ only). mol_per_kg = g_per_kg / molarMassG. Literature numbers are preferred over forcing charge balance. salinity_g_per_kg is the summed cited SUBSTANCES ions, not the ~34.8% total-solids headline (omitted carbonate/borate/phosphate). Density 1.30 kg/L is Teeple specific gravity 1.30 at 21 °C — screening, not a CTD. Not Texas Gulf / Corpus Christi seawater; literature assay is not a mineral concession.

lithium.note: Teeple 1929 LiCl 0.021 wt% of brine → 0.0344 g/kg Li+ (SUBSTANCES LiCl molar mass). Screening, not a concession grade.
